interaction.I01_entity_navigation: Follow semantic resource links, inspect neighbours/details and change focus
interaction.I02_faceted_filtering: Iteratively constrain entity/result sets using categorical, numeric, hierarchical or path facets
interaction.I03_visual_query: Construct/edit a graph, diagram, flow or form representing query constraints
interaction.I04_text_query: Author/refine/run a formal query through an editor
interaction.I05_controlled_language: Build a constrained, verbalised query by choosing allowed elements
interaction.I06_free_language: Express a query or exploration request in unrestricted natural language
interaction.I07_example_query: Use entity tuples, example records or exemplar graph patterns as query input
interaction.I08_coordinated_analysis: Select/brush/filter linked views while preserving selection/context
interaction.I09_visual_configuration: Choose/configure reusable visualisation views of selected KG results
interaction.I10_reuse_history: Restore/branch/save/share an exploration or query state
interaction.I11_curation_modifier: Annotate/edit underlying graph facts as part of an already-attested exploration workflow; not sufficient alone

guidance.G01_valid_next_step: Offer schema- or instance-compatible next actions/constraints, with stated validity or non-empty-result intent
guidance.G02_lexical_completion: Autocomplete/search labels, terms or query snippets using current context
guidance.G03_semantic_ranking: Rank candidate entities,relations,facets or paths by semantic/context relevance
guidance.G04_query_expansion_relaxation: Recommend/derive extensions, alternatives or relaxed query constraints
guidance.G05_template_entry: Provide predefined questions,patterns or domain workflows to establish an exploration entry point
guidance.G06_context_explanation: Explain relation/path/provenance or current query/filter effects in the interaction
guidance.G07_visualisation_recommendation: Recommend or enable appropriate views based on selected data structure/types
guidance.G08_personalisation: Adapt ranked results/actions to explicit or inferred user profile/preferences
guidance.G09_language_generation: Generate interpretable question/query candidates or graph/formal-query structures from language input
guidance.G10_orientation_feedback: Provide explicit navigation orientation,progress,interim results or visible state changes to steer exploration

visualisation.V01_node_link: Entity/query/association nodes and labelled relation links
visualisation.V03_table_list: Tabular or list results with inspectable resource identity/details
visualisation.V05_timeline: Temporal ordering or time-oriented KG results
visualisation.V09_text_document: Linked text evidence,annotations,descriptions or natural-language explanation
visualisation.V11_coordinated_views: Multiple synchronised views of the same query/selection; report concrete view types too

data_model.B01_rdf: Actual RDF/Linked Data object asserted in source
data_model.B02_property_graph: Actual labelled property graph with entity/relation/property semantics asserted in source
data_model.B03_typed_legacy_graph: Legacy typed graph model with explicit semantics; criterion boundary handled separately
data_model.B04_generic_graph_collection: Collections of topology-labelled graphs without established KG object
data_model.B05_mixed_models: At least two source-attested graph model classes, individually specified
data_model.B06_schema_only: Only schema/ontology/vocabulary object; keep eligibility separate

access.A01_endpoint_query: Queries to a remote source endpoint
access.A03_local_store: Local loaded/embedded database or graph store
access.A04_federation: One workflow/query accesses multiple sources through stated federation
access.A06_projection_cache: Explicit cached/materialised/preprocessed projection supporting the interaction

evaluation.E01_demonstration: Illustrative system demo with no recruited or measured user outcomes
evaluation.E02_case_study: Worked application/domain scenario; distinguish authored example from observed user use
evaluation.E03_formative_user: Elicitation/co-design/think-aloud/qualitative feedback used to develop or refine an interface
evaluation.E04_single_system_user: Participants perform tasks/use one interface; no within-study alternative baseline
evaluation.E05_comparative_user: Human performance/experience comparison against an explicit within-study comparator
evaluation.E06_offline_accuracy: Computational retrieval/ranking/correctness/ablation benchmark without human workflow outcomes
evaluation.E07_performance: Measured execution/rendering/runtime/resource behaviour with workload/version/hardware conditions
evaluation.E08_deployment: Adoption/log/visitor/deployment evidence; not a recruited usability trial
evaluation.E10_contextual_needs: Interview/survey of needs or existing practice without developing/evaluating an identifiable exploration workflow
evaluation.E11_contextual_review: Survey/review synthesising other systems; not a new primary system

scalability.S01_measured_runtime: Numeric measured latency/throughput with stated workload
scalability.S03_reported_data_scale: Authors report source/graph size without a measured interaction workload
scalability.S04_reported_visual_scale: Authors report number/shape/density of visible nodes or view-size advice
scalability.S05_strategy_only: Bounded retrieval,pagination,aggregation,sampling,cache,precomputation or progressive updates without measured performance

definitions.query_pattern: Query, filter, constraint or graph pattern formulated to retrieve data. Constants or result counts on a query diagram do not alone make it a data-result view.
definitions.data_result: Returned or matching source entities, values or assertions under a stated query/exploration scope, rather than the syntactic query pattern.
definitions.source_schema: Source ontology/schema/vocabulary structure as the displayed object. Typed query nodes do not by themselves establish this role.
definitions.computed_association: Associations derived by a specified computation, such as similarity or inferred links, rather than source assertions assumed from appearance.

representation_roles.missingness: unspecified means no role has been established; it does not mean that a representation is absent.
representation_roles.scope: Source-qualified named views only. Four assertions in two QueryVOWL reports are qualified; all other visual assertions remain unspecified.
